question: Should `isReplySessionInitConflictError` become a permanent public `openclaw/plugin-sdk/error-runtime` API for external channel/plugin authors?
rationale: The implementation is technically bounded, but publishing this predicate commits OpenClaw to its exact conflict-message grammar, wrapping traversal, and future compatibility behavior for third-party plugins.

options.title: Sponsor the public predicate
options.body: Accept the narrow SDK contract, require a rebase onto current `main`, and retain focused compatibility tests for strict messages and wrapped errors.

options.title: Keep the classifier internal
options.body: Remove the public SDK export and surface-budget change, then consolidate only bundled channel callers behind an internal core helper.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the public predicate
recommendation.body: Accept the narrow SDK contract, require a rebase onto current `main`, and retain focused compatibility tests for strict messages and wrapped errors.

likelyOwner.reason: This is an API-scope choice rather than a mechanical channel repair.
